from hep_lfx import HepComponent, business, payload
from lfx.io import DataInput, Output
from lfx.schema import Data
class HepSummary(HepComponent):
 display_name='汇总常规巡检结果'
 inputs=[DataInput(name='check_status', display_name='check_status', required=True),DataInput(name='check_baseline', display_name='check_baseline', required=True),DataInput(name='check_reachability', display_name='check_reachability', required=True)]
 outputs=[Output(name="result",display_name="结果",method="build")]
 async def build(self)->Data:
  return Data(data=business().aggregate('routine',{'status':payload(self.check_status),'baseline':payload(self.check_baseline),'reachability':payload(self.check_reachability)}))
